title: fix(ai-ollama): keep parallel same-name tool calls apart when ids are missing

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@tanstack/ai-ollama': patch
+---
+
+Keep parallel calls to the same tool apart when Ollama sends no tool-call id. The fallback id was `<name>_<Date.now()>`, so two calls to one tool in the same millisecond shared an id and the second call was merged into the first instead of running. The fallback id is now unique per call.

@@ -54,6 +54,7 @@ beforeEach(() => {
 
 afterEach(() => {
   vi.unstubAllEnvs()
+  vi.restoreAllMocks()
 })
 
 describe('OllamaTextAdapter construction', () => {
@@ -277,7 +278,46 @@ describe('OllamaTextAdapter.chatStream (tool calls)', () => {
     const startChunk = chunks.find((c) => c.type === 'TOOL_CALL_START') as
       | { toolCallId: string; toolCallName: string }
       | undefined
-    expect(startChunk!.toolCallId).toMatch(/^search_\d+/)
+    expect(startChunk!.toolCallId).toMatch(/^search-\d+-/)
+  })
+
+  it('keeps two parallel calls to the same tool apart when Ollama omits ids', async () => {
+    // Same millisecond for both calls: the old `name_Date.now()` id collided here
+    vi.spyOn(Date, 'now').mockReturnValue(1_700_000_000_000)
+    chatMock.mockResolvedValueOnce(
+      asyncIterable([
+        {
+          message: {
+            role: 'assistant',
+            content: '',
+            tool_calls: [
+              { function: { name: 'search', arguments: { q: 'cats' } } },
+              { function: { name: 'search', arguments: { q: 'dogs' } } },
+            ],
+          },
+          done: true,
+          done_reason: 'stop',
+        },
+      ]),
+    )
+
+    const chunks = await collectStream(
+      createOllamaChat('llama3.2').chatStream({
+        threadId: 'thread-1',
+        logger: testLogger,
+        model: 'llama3.2',
+        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'find cats and dogs' }],
+        tools: [searchTool],
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const startIds = chunks.flatMap((c) =>
+      c.type === 'TOOL_CALL_START' ? [c.toolCallId] : [],
+    )
+    const ends = chunks.flatMap((c) => (c.type === 'TOOL_CALL_END' ? [c] : []))
+    expect(new Set(startIds).size).toBe(2)
+    expect(ends.map((e) => e.toolCallId)).toEqual(startIds)
+    expect(ends.map((e) => e.args)).toEqual(['{"q":"cats"}', '{"q":"dogs"}'])
   })
 
   async function toolCallEnd(args: unknown) {

@@ -33,5 +33,29 @@ for (const provider of providersFor('parallel-tool-calls')) {
       // Wait for text response after tool execution
       await waitForAssistantText(page, 'Stratocaster')
     })
+
+    // Ollama sends no tool-call ids, so this guards the fallback id
+    test('keeps parallel calls to the same tool apart', async ({
+      page,
+      testId,
+      aimockPort,
+    }) => {
+      await page.goto(
+        featureUrl(provider, 'parallel-tool-calls', testId, aimockPort),
+      )
+
+      await sendMessage(
+        page,
+        '[parallel-same] compare guitars 1 and 2, then 3 and 4',
+      )
+      await waitForResponse(page)
+
+      const toolNames = (await getToolCalls(page)).map((t) => t.name)
+      expect(
+        toolNames.filter((name) => name === 'compareGuitars'),
+      ).toHaveLength(2)
+
+      await waitForAssistantText(page, 'Both comparisons are done')
+    })
   })
 }
